description: This Java class 'SagePayServices' provides methods for integrating with SagePay payment gateway, including payment authentication, authorization, release, void, and refund operations. It constructs HTTP requests, handles responses, and manages payment transaction states.

classes.name: SagePayServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle SagePay payment gateway operations such as authentication, authorization, release, void, and refund.

methods.name: buildSagePayProperties
methods.description: Builds and returns a map of SagePay configuration properties based on the provided context and delegator.

methods.name: paymentAuthentication
methods.description: Performs payment authentication with SagePay, constructs request parameters, sends HTTP request, and processes response.

methods.name: paymentAuthorisation
methods.description: Handles payment authorization process with SagePay, including request construction, sending, and response handling.

methods.name: paymentRelease
methods.description: Releases a payment hold or captures funds in SagePay, managing request and response.

methods.name: paymentVoid
methods.description: Voids a payment transaction in SagePay, sending request and processing response.

methods.name: paymentRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund through SagePay, constructing request, executing, and handling response.
